integrity: All displayed equations are analytical claims with explicit proof and scope; finite computations are supplementary only. Full text of Panja and relevant sections of general UCP literature compared. Scientific independence not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Gaussian critical scaling and logarithmic correction are proved for beta weights only; general admissible radial weights receive ballistic but not universal Gaussian scaling. The map-specific result builds on a previously published Kraus representation. Independent publication-priority review and validation have not occurred.
title: Ballistic and Gaussian survival fronts for the weighted-Bergman completely positive map
